## `src/encoder/index`

### Barcode

**Kind:** interface

```typescript
export interface Barcode
```

The result of {@link encodeBarcode}: module bits with their total width.

### encodeBarcode

**Kind:** function

```typescript
function encodeBarcode(symbology: BarcodeSymbology, data: string): Barcode;
```

Encode `data` into a linear barcode using the package-local FWS graph.

#### Parameters

| Name      | Type             | Description |
| --------- | ---------------- | ----------- |
| symbology | BarcodeSymbology |             |
| data      | string           |             |

#### Contract

- **@throws:** when the payload is invalid for the selected symbology.
